item.name: Webhook samples
item.description:
Terra's documented example notifications, sent to {{local_url}} (your local handler) unchanged. Signature: terra-signature: t=<timestamp>,v1=<signature>; HMAC-SHA256 keyed by the webhook's signing secret over the timestamp, a "." and the raw body. Ignore schemes other than v1. Source: Terra docs, “Webhooks”, https://docs.tryterra.co/unified-api/integration-setup/setting-up-data-destinations/webhooks

Headers that carry a signature hold the placeholder Terra prints, so a handler that verifies signatures will reject these: to send correctly signed requests, use https://aifitnessapi.com/webhooks/send-sample.mjs. Respond: Respond within 8 seconds; accept immediately (return 200) and process asynchronously. Sustained timeouts, 5xx and repeated 4xx can trip a per-destination circuit breaker.

Payload library with JSON Schemas: https://aifitnessapi.com/webhooks#terra.
